answer: In an agent economy trading orchard and grove maintenance, each bidding identity must lock 100 tokens for 30 days, and its share of contract opportunities is proportional to its locked stake. An attacker can forge a thousand identities, but must immobilize 100,000 tokens; splitting the same stake across more names earns no larger total share. The defense makes influence depend on committed capital, so extra identities carry a measurable financing cost.
